stories.title: Nvidia is shutting Chinese firms out of renting its GPUs through clouds

cards.title: Key reasons · 1/2
items: Cloud partners reportedly need at least 51% of business from non-Chinese customers
Hits neoclouds in Singapore, Malaysia, Japan that rent GPUs to Chinese firms
Applies to new contracts only; Nvidia already more than halved its authorized Asian buyers

cards.title: Key reasons · 2/2
items: US Commerce rule requires licenses for large compute rented to China-headquartered firms

cards.title: What it means
cards.text: Watch Asian neocloud orders and whether Commerce tightens rules on renting compute
